audit_name: Stage A.13 Phase A13.1 Zero-Training Reconciliation

documentation_discrepancy_erratum.historical_issue_1: A.11-R2 (832326b) reported R2_ARM_2_LAST_TOKEN MP-2 scores of 75.00% / 87.50% / 0.00% (Seeds 42, 43, 44; mean 54.17%). Stage A.12 (96ffaad) docs/STAGE_A12.md accurately recorded A12_ARM_1_R2_BASELINE as 0.00% / 100.00% / 18.75% (mean 39.58%), matching data/manifests/stage_a12_v1.json. However, README.md and docs/04-experiments.md in 96ffaad erroneously reported 87.50% / 100.00% / 0.00% (mean 62.50%).
documentation_discrepancy_erratum.cause_of_doc_discrepancy: README.md and docs/04-experiments.md inadvertently cited intermediate/swapped draft numbers rather than the finalized manifest data/manifests/stage_a12_v1.json. docs/STAGE_A12.md contains the true empirical measurements from the remote Kaggle run.
documentation_discrepancy_erratum.cause_of_a11r2_vs_a12_baseline_divergenc: In scripts/run_stage_a11r2.py, eb_train_suite was instantiated once with fixed seed=42 before the seed loop, and balanced_plan was constructed once before calling seed_all(seed). In contrast, in scripts/run_stage_a12.py, eb_suite_train was called with seed=seed inside the per-seed loop, and plan_fn (build_a11r2_balanced_plan) was invoked after seed_all(seed), which drew seed-specific training entities for Seeds 43 and 44 and altered the pseudo-random batch shuffling sequence.
documentation_discrepancy_erratum.phase_1_table_2_bug_explanation: In scripts/diagnose_stage_a12_seeds.py (lines 278, 292, 398, 410), predictions were extracted via tag_logits[:, [6, 7]], corresponding to attributes 'clay' and 'ice' (or 'crystalline' / 'glass') rather than TAG_IDS = (10, 15) ('flammable' and 'conductive'). Because targets were scored on the wrong attribute dimensions, all seeds produced 0.00% accuracy on Table 2.
